description: This Java class, MetadataModelFactory, is a factory for creating and manipulating Metadata objects, including empty, null, and initialized instances. It provides methods to generate Metadata from JSON objects or strings, and offers builder methods for constructing Metadata instances.

classes.name: MetadataModelFactory
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods to create and initialize Metadata objects, including factory methods that generate Metadata from JSON objects or strings, and builder methods for Metadata.

methods.name: emptyMetadata
methods.description: Returns a new immutable empty Metadata instance.

methods.name: nullMetadata
methods.description: Returns a new immutable Metadata instance representing null.

methods.name: newMetadata
methods.description: Creates a new Metadata instance initialized with values from a given JsonObject, validating the keys against a pattern.

methods.name: newMetadata
methods.description: Creates a new Metadata instance initialized from a JSON string representing a JsonObject.

methods.name: newMetadataBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for Metadata.

methods.name: newMetadataBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder initialized with an existing Metadata instance.
